summary: Implemented finite Go-only capture qualification for four pinned PR23 scenarios and five profiles each. CheckCaptures recomputes all native traces with effectsreplay.ReplayJSON, validates full Go state/view snapshots and Go-rendered browser DOM/disabled behavior, compares effect descriptors and pending state, and invokes N4 CheckOrdering for lifecycle and correlation checks.

evidence.summary: Pins the exact command, exit code, log hashes, and owned source hashes.
All four N2 tests passed, including the explicit real PR23 capture integration.
Implementation behavior, evidence, repair history, strictness, and scope limits.
N5 full-package regression result after N2 pending-state implementation.
N5 semantic mutation controls, including Go state/tree, rendered DOM, disabled click, ordering/correlation, and required-suite removal.

limitations: Acceptance is limited to the four exact scenario byte pins and the five named profiles per scenario.
No JavaScript or Chromium is executed by CheckCaptures; browser captures are compared against Go replay and Go-rendered views.
This does not prove arbitrary module, browser, pixel, JavaScript, or event-stream equivalence and does not replace N3 source/build/ABI admission.
Generic-map capture documents tolerate extra metadata keys; required fields and consumed values are checked explicitly.
